ideas.name: London close fade
ideas.why: Europe squares its positions into its close (10:30 CT): the morning's move is partly unwound

ideas.name: pull to the developing POC
ideas.why: the day's busiest price is where both sides agreed; late in a balanced day price drifts back to it

ideas.name: acceptance outside value
ideas.why: price that has held 15 minutes outside the developing value area is being accepted there: the auction moves on

ideas.name: closing at the highs, five bars
ideas.why: bars that keep closing at their highs show buyers in control through each minute (sellers mirrored)

ideas.name: VWAP 1-sigma band fade
ideas.why: a stretch to VWAP's 1-sigma band in a range day attracts the session's mean-reverting liquidity

ideas.name: flip1 after a quiet 30 minutes
ideas.why: the first flip after a long stretch without one is a real change, not chop

ideas.name: flip1 in chop (3+ flips in an hour)
ideas.why: in a choppy hour each flip is noise that reverses (expected to hurt)

ideas.name: flip1 after volume dried up
ideas.why: a flip out of a low-volume lull is a release of pent-up orders

ideas.name: flip1 in the first 3 days of a month
ideas.why: month-start inflows (pensions, payroll contributions) push index futures up; long flips gain

ideas.name: flip1 outside today's value
ideas.why: a flip away from value is the auction extending; inside value it rotates
